1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __tissue that is not in direct contact with the cranium__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from forceps, scissors, suction devices, or ablation probes__.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __such that the device creates a working channel that is laterally displaced from the insertion path by at least the radial expansion distance__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a stent structure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from forceps, scissors, suction devices, or ablation probes__.

9. (Original) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the working channel created by radial expansion is laterally offset from the initial insertion path__.

11. (Original) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue.

12. (Original) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.

13. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent __while maintaining the stent in an expanded state__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __in a controlled manner to prevent tissue trauma__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __selected from forceps, scissors, suction devices, or ablation probes__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the stent remains in place to maintain the working channel after removal of the expandable bodies__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
